title: Gas Station

solutions.optimal:
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def canCompleteCircuit(self, gas: List[int], cost: List[int]) -> int:
        total = 0
        tank = 0
        start = 0

        for i, (g, c) in enumerate(zip(gas, cost)):
            gain = g - c
            total += gain
            tank += gain
            if tank < 0:
                start = i + 1
                tank = 0

        return start if total >= 0 else -1
